We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 6 reactions for target SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

We need to produce JSON route with 6 reaction steps. We need to find appropriate templates. Could manually construct plausible route based on hints: steps enumerated forward: 1) aromatic amine attacks phenylsulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide formation (N-S bond formed, S-Cl broken). So retrosynthesis: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride and aromatic amine. So first disconnection: target -> sulfonyl chloride (phenylsulfonyl chloride with fluorophenyl?) Actually target has sulfonyl attached to aromatic amine (the aromatic ring is part of larger fused system). The sulfonyl group is attached to aromatic amine (N attached to sulfonyl). So retrosynthesis: remove sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (ArSO2Cl) and the amine (the rest of molecule). So step1: apply template for sulfonamide formation reversed.

We need template ID. We can search for template that forms sulfonamide from sulfonyl chloride and amine. Use search criteria: functional_groups_formed: ["sulfonamides"], functional_groups_broken: ["halide"], maybe also bonds formed N-S, broken S-Cl. Let's try search with proper format: bonds_formed and broken need numeric format; we can omit them. Use functional groups only.
